63571.subject: Agricultural Science
63571.question_text:
Use the information below to answer this question.
In an experiment on soil porosity, the following results were obtained:
Volume of dry soil = 52cm³
Volume of water= 48cm³
Volume of soil and water=78cm³

Determine the volume of airspace in the soil sample.
63571.explanation:
The expected total volume of soil and water = 52\(cm^3 + 48cm^3= 100cm^3\)

 Given total volume of soil and water = 78\(cm^3\)

Difference in total volume = 100\(cm^3 - 78cm^3\) = 22\(cm^3\)

So, this difference represents air space in the soil sample = 22\(cm^3\)

63572.subject: Agricultural Science
63572.question_text:
Use the information below to answer this question.
In an experiment on soil porosity, the following results were obtained:
Volume of dry soil = 52cm³
Volume of water= 48cm³
Volume of soil and water=78cm³

Calculate the porosity of the soil sample
63572.explanation:
Porosity of the soil sample = \(\frac{volume of air space in the soil}{ volume of soil sample}\)  x 100
                                           = \(\frac{22cm^3}{52cm^3}\)  x 100 = \(\frac{2200}{52}\) = 42.31 %
